title: Border Guard & Result Customs Deliverable Gates
problem: Tasks and deliverables lack tamper-evident cryptographic binding, risking scope creep and fabricated test passes.
evidence: Verified in WS6 (EXP-WS6-BG-001) and WS7 (EXP-WS7-CUSTOMS-001). Mutants MUT-09 and MUT-10 killed.
proposed_change_boundary: Add HMAC passport sealing outbound and deliverable artifact verification inbound.
migration_impact: New HMAC key generation required; unsigned legacy tasks must be re-dispatched.
rollback: Accept legacy unsigned passports with warning.
known_risks: Network clock skew > 5s may invalidate time-bound tokens.
stop_condition: Acceptance of any deliverable with mismatched task version or non-zero exit code.
